reports.desc: I signed up for what I believed to be a free trial on a resume site through ChatGPT. I had attempted to cancel 3 times on my mobile device after I realized it wasnt quite what I was looking for and 7 days later the payment was drafted from my account. I initially was confused because I had cancelled. So I got on my phone to make sure and it hadnt cancelled. So I attempted again. It is discovered you cannot cancel on your mobile device which is not disclosed anywhere on the site or terms and policies. I logged onto my desktop to cancel and was able to do so that way. When I emailed explaining I had proof that I could not cancel on my mobile device although I was told it was cancelled I just requested my refund, They refused. When I told them I had time stamps proving this and that I would be reporting them for deceptive practices, they did not respond.
They will not allow you to actually cancel and continue doing a monthly charge and telling you it’s because you didn’t cancel no matter how many times you complain about it

Instant Hydration offered a deal where you would receive a discounted rate on their product when you sign up for a subscription that you can “cancel anytime”   However their website has no cancellation process and uses a “cancel” button in a  deceptive way.  There is no reminder before you are billed for your next subscription shipment. Then, if you sign on your account and select cancel under manage subscription, it takes you only to a page to delay your subscription shipment. If you select “cancel” on that screen, it only “cancels” the process of delaying your shipment and takes you back to the menu- it does not cancel your subscription.
